correctness.rationale: All 12 positive D4 roots are derived independently from the standard coordinate system. Exhaustive incomparable-face enumeration yields f=(12,24,12,1) and exact augmented boundary ranks (1,9,10,1), giving rational Betti (2,5,1). Orbit-simplex enumeration for the transposition gives f=(9,9,1), an explicit elementary free-face collapse to a 7-vertex 8-edge graph with two isolated vertices. The three-cycle and full S3 have coincident root orbits and fixed complex one interval plus four isolated vertices. Lefschetz reduced traces (-2,0,4) and nonnegative integral irreducible multiplicities uniquely force H2=sign, H1=trivial+2standard. Standalone exact checker regenerated results. The proof is finite and exhaustive, not a bounded approximation of an infinite claim.

value.rationale: Type D4 is the first non-shellable member of the recent root-poset antichain study and is exceptional for outer Dynkin triality. The theorem identifies the exact representation on two distinct homology degrees, including an orientation-sign reversal not visible in homotopy rank and two standard modules. The geometric fixed loci reveal an unusual equality of C3 and S3 fixed sets despite distinct C2 topology. This is a natural complete equivariant invariant of a motivated finite complex rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
